ayahs.translation_bn: মুনাফিকরা যখন তোমার কাছে আসে তখন তারা বলে- ‘আমরা সাক্ষ্য দিচ্ছি যে, আপনি অবশ্যই আল্লাহর রসূল।’ আল্লাহ জানেন, অবশ্যই তুমি তাঁর রসূল আর আল্লাহ সাক্ষ্য দিচ্ছেন যে, মুনাফিকরা অবশ্যই মিথ্যেবাদী।

ayahs.translation_en: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allah. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

ayahs.translation_bn: তুমি যখন তাদের দিকে তাকাও তখন তাদের শারীরিক গঠন তোমাকে চমৎকৃত করে। আর যখন তারা কথা বলে তখন তুমি তাদের কথা আগ্রহ ভরে শুন, অথচ তারা দেয়ালে ঠেস দেয়া কাঠের মত (দেখন- সুরত, কিন্ত কার্যক্ষেত্রে কিছুই না)। কোন শোরগোল হলেই তারা সেটাকে নিজেদের বিরুদ্ধে মনে করে (কারণ তাদের অপরাধী মন সব সময়ে শঙ্কিত থাকে- এই বুঝি তাদের কুকীর্তি ফাঁস হয়ে গেল)। এরাই শত্রু, কাজেই তাদের ব্যাপারে সতর্ক থাক। এদের উপর আছে আল্লাহর গযব, তাদেরকে কীভাবে (সত্য পথ থেকে) ফিরিয়ে নেয়া হচ্ছে!

[They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded?

english_translations.sahih_international: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded?
english_translations.pickthall: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When thou lookest at them, their exteriors please thee; and when they speak, thou listenest to their words. They are as (worthless as hollow) pieces of timber propped up, (unable to stand on their own). They think that every cry is against them. They are the enemies; so beware of them. The curse of Allah be on them! How are they deluded (away from the Truth)!
english_translations.shakir: And when you see them, their persons will please you, and If they speak, you will listen to their speech; (they are) as if they were big pieces of wood clad with garments; they think every cry to be against them. They are the enemy, therefore beware of them; may Allah destroy them, whence are they turned back?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Their physical appearance attracts you when you see them and when they speak, you carefully listen to them. In fact, they are like propped up hollow trunks of wood (They are so cowardly) they think that every cry which they hear is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May God condemn them. Where are they turning to, leaving behind the Truth?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when you look at them, their bodies please you; and when they speak, you listen to their words. They are as blocks of wood propped up. They think that every cry is against them. They are the enemies, so beware of them. May Allah curse them! How are they denying (or deviating from) the Right Path.
english_translations.arberry: When thou seest them, their bodies please thee; but when they speak, thou listenest to their speech, and it is as they were propped-up timbers. They think every cry is against them. They are the enemy; so beware of them. God assail them! How they are perverted!

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā qīla lahum taʿālaw yastaghfir lakum rasūlu l-lahi lawwaw ruūsahum wara-aytahum yaṣuddūna wahum mus'takbirūna
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদেরকে যখন বলা হয়, ‘এসো, আল্লাহর রসূল তোমাদের জন্য ক্ষমা প্রার্থনা করবেন, তখন তারা মাথা নেড়ে অস্বীকৃতি জানায়, তখন তুমি দেখতে পাও তারা সদম্ভে তাদের মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
ayahs.conventional_en: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

ayahs.translation_bn: তারা বলে- ‘আমরা যদি মাদীনায় প্রত্যাবর্তন করি, তাহলে সম্মানীরা অবশ্য অবশ্যই হীনদেরকে সেখানে থেকে বহিষ্কার করবে।’ কিন্তু সমস্ত মান মর্যাদা তো আল্লাহর, তাঁর রসূলের এবং মু’মিনদের; কিন্তু মুনাফিকরা তা জানে না।

ayahs.translation_bn: হে মু’মিনগণ! তোমাদের ধন-সম্পদ আর তোমাদের সন্তানাদি তোমাদেরকে যেন আল্লাহর স্মরণ হতে গাফিল করে না দেয়। যারা এমন করবে তারাই ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত।

english_translations.sahih_international: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."
english_translations.pickthall: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: and spend something (in charity) out of the substance which We have bestowed on you, before Death should come to any of you and he should say, "O my Lord! why didst Thou not give me respite for a little while? I should then have given (largely) in charity, and I should have been one of the doers of good".
english_translations.shakir: And spend out of what We have given you before death comes to one of you, so that he should say: My Lord! why didst Thou not respite me to a near term, so that I should have given alms and been of the doers of good deeds?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Spend for the cause of God out of what We have given you before death approaches you, and say, "Lord, would that you would give me respite for a short time so that I could spend for Your cause and become one of those who do good".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And spend (in charity) of that with which We have provided you, before death comes to one of you and he says: "My Lord! If only You would give me respite for a little while (i.e. return to the worldly life), then I should give Sadaqah (i.e. Zakat) of my wealth, and be among the righteous [i.e. perform Hajj (pilgrimage to Makkah)].
english_translations.arberry: Expend of what We have provided you before that death comes upon one of you and he says, 'O my Lord, if only Thou wouldst defer me unto a near term, so that I may make freewill offering, and so I may become one of the righteous.'

ayahs.transliteration: walan yu-akhira l-lahu nafsan idhā jāa ajaluhā wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ কাউকে কক্ষনো অবকাশ দেন না যখন তার নির্ধারিত সময় এসে যায়। তোমরা যা কর সে সম্পর্কে আল্লাহ পুরোপুরি খবর রাখেন।
ayahs.translation_en: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
ayahs.conventional_en: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহ কাউকে কক্ষনো অবকাশ দেন না যখন তার নির্ধারিত সময় এসে যায়। তোমরা যা কর সে সম্পর্কে আল্লাহ পুরোপুরি খবর রাখেন।
ayahs.meta_bn: অমোঘ আয়ুষ্কাল: নির্ধারিত সময় উপস্থিত হলে কাউকে অবকাশ না দেওয়ার পরম নীতি
ayahs.meta_en: Immutable Temporal Quota: Absolute Non-Negotiability of the Terminal Expiry
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا: the absolute immutability of the programmed biological lifespan timestamp.

english_translations.sahih_international: But never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
english_translations.pickthall: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But to no soul will Allah grant respite when the time appointed (for it) has come; and Allah is well acquainted with (all) that ye do.
english_translations.shakir: And Allah does not respite a soul when its appointed term has come, and Allah is Aware of what you do.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God will never grant respite to any soul when its appointed time has come. God is Well-Aware of what you do.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And Allah grants respite to none when his appointed time (death) comes. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
english_translations.arberry: But God will never defer any soul when its term comes. And God is aware of the things you do.
